subject: You're in — Baskets of Hope 2026
body:
Dear [your-name],

Thank you for reserving your seat at Rohit's Baskets of Hope, November 3, 2026. We can't wait to share the evening with you.

Details:
  When:  Tuesday, November 3, 2026 — 6:00 PM
  Where: Rohit Group Office, 10130 112 St NW, Edmonton
  Bring: 12 comfort items (or partner with a friend)

Questions? Reply to this email.

With gratitude,
Rohit's Baskets of Hope
